# video2text — Fully Local, Speaker-Diarized Transcription

> video2text is a fully local macOS (Apple Silicon) app that turns an mp4 video or audio file into a speaker-diarized transcript. It is built and maintained by neurosam.AI (Neurosam AI Inc. / 주식회사 뉴로샘에이아이 / 뉴로샘AI). Open source under the MIT License.

## Why video2text

Recorded meetings, interviews, and lectures need to become text, but cloud transcription services (Otter.ai, Whisper API, Zoom AI Companion) require uploading the recording — content and voices included — to a third-party server. video2text runs the entire pipeline on-device on Apple Silicon instead.

Key capabilities:
- **Fully local processing** — speech recognition (mlx-whisper) and speaker diarization (pyannote.audio) both run on-device, no upload
- **Automatic voice matching** — registered voice profiles (SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN embeddings) are matched against diarized speakers automatically
- **Rematch / relabel** — fix speaker matches without rerunning the full pipeline
- **Self-contained app bundle** — copies to another Apple Silicon Mac with no separate install
- **Three export formats** — TXT, SRT, JSON

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/neurosamAI/video2text
cd video2text
./build.sh
```
